See also: repondré and rêpondre

French

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • repondre (obsolete) [17th–18th CC.]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Middle French respondre, from Old French respondre, from Late Latin respondere, from Latin respondēre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ʁe.pɔ̃dʁ/
  • Audio (Paris):(file)
  • Audio (Switzerland (Valais)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Brétigny-sur-Orge)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: ré‧pondre

Verb

[edit]

répondre

  1. to reply, to answer [with à ‘to a question’]
    Tu dois répondre aux questions que je te pose.
    You must answer the questions I ask you.
  2. (law) to answer for [with de]
    répondre de ses actes ― to answer for one's deeds
